tools.name: list_threads
tools.title: List Threads

Each thread summarizes its subject, senders, recipients, preview, labels, and message count; read its messages with get_thread. Threads with no received message, such as a new outbound email awaiting a reply, appear only when labels includes sent. Filter by labels, sender, recipient, subject, or before/after datetime. tools.name: connect_app

tools.description: Create an account at an app as an inbox, or sign an inbox that already holds one back in: mints a browser sign-in session and returns a single-use magic URL to open in the client that will hold the sign-in (usually the agent's own browser session), plus the ID of the pending sign-in key. To sign in to an app that is not registered (connect_app 404s, yet list_accounts may show accounts there), open the app, start its Sign in with AgentID, and pass the auth token the sign-in page shows to authorize_inbox.
